summary: Frontend-only E2E test of new inline lead-reassign (handover) feature in Staff 'My Leads'. All 5 primary assertions from the review request PASS. One regression path (converted-lead hides reassign row) was not directly exercised because staff has 0 converted leads; verified via code inspection. Test data was reassigned back to the original owner at the end so dataset is restored.

verification_results.staff_can_open_lead_and_sees_reassign_ro: PASS — [data-testid=lead-reassign-row] and [data-testid=lead-reassign-select] both present; current owner shown as 'BLR Staff (me) · Staff'
verification_results.dropdown_lists_only_KM_BLR_colleagues_in: PASS — 5 options rendered, all KM_BLR: ADHISH K JEES (Office admin), BLR Office Admin (Office admin), BLR Staff (me) · Staff, JISHNA JEEMON (Staff), SOURAV RAJ CM (Staff). No outside-office users leaked.
verification_results.handover_success_toast_dialog_closes_lea: PASS — After selecting ADHISH K JEES: toast 'Lead handed over to ADHISH K JEES' shown, LeadDetailDialog closed automatically, My Leads count dropped 10 → 9. POST /api/leads/{id}/reassign returned 200.
verification_results.journey_timeline_shows_reassignment_entr: PASS — Opening the same lead as office admin (blr1@finflow.com), Journey shows 'Reassigned BLR Staff → ADHISH K JEES · Sep 25, 2026, 10:10 PM · BLR Staff' with data-testid=journey-event-assignment-<uuid>. Multiple prior assignments also rendered correctly.
verification_results.activity_page_shows_lead_assigned_entrie: PASS — Activity page (/activity) lists 'BLR Staff · lead.assigned — Revathi Prasad' with note 'Reassigned Revathi Prasad from BLR Staff to ADHISH K JEES' and office badge 'KM BLR'. Restore entry also shown ('BLR Office Admin · lead.assigned — Revathi Prasad · Reassigned Revathi Prasad from ADHISH K JEES to BLR Staff').
verification_results.office_admin_can_also_use_inline_reassig: PASS — blr1@finflow.com opened the same lead in the CRM and successfully reassigned back to BLR Staff via the same inline select. Toast 'Lead handed over to BLR Staff' shown; journey and activity updated.
verification_results.cross_office_guard: PASS (indirectly) — The dropdown fetched from /users/assignable returned only 5 KM_BLR members. No cross-office users appeared in either the staff's or the office admin's dropdown.
verification_results.regression_converted_lead_hides_reassign: NOT DIRECTLY EXERCISED — Staff had 0 converted leads at test time. Verified by code inspection of LeadDetailDialog.jsx that the reassign row is gated on 'not converted'.
verification_results.regression_note_add_and_status_change_st: PASS — Note textarea and Add note button visible; status pills (New/Not Connected/Interested/Follow-up/Converted/Application Submitted/Admission Confirmed/Fee Paid/Completed/Not Turned/Lost) still rendered above the note section in the same dialog.

critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetailDialog reassign row correctly uses data-testid=lead-reassign-row / lead-reassign-select / lead-reassign-opt-<userId>; matches spec. Self option is properly marked '(me)'.
Journey timeline event rendered with data-testid=journey-event-assignment-<uuid> and shows 'Reassigned <from> → <to>' plus actor name and timestamp — matches spec.

Activity page renders lead.assigned entries with actor name, subject lead, note, and office badge. Note auto-generated by _assignment_event/log_lead_event is exactly 'Reassigned <lead> from <X> to <Y>' — matches spec.
Handover UX: after staff reassigns to someone else, dialog closes and list refetches — count drops correctly (10 → 9).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 7 exercised checks; 1 regression path (converted lead) not exercised for lack of data

seed_data_creation: None. One live lead (Revathi Prasad, id=bccf3460-20c9-4f72-b4c4-9d57ac4a8644) was reassigned BLR Staff → ADHISH K JEES for the test and then reassigned back ADHISH K JEES → BLR Staff by the office admin. Dataset restored to pre-test state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The staff harness (staff.blr@kmfoundation.online) currently owns 10 My Leads (E1 review said ~9; extra lead is a pre-existing 'TEST_notif_1bc22c' from a prior iteration — not created by this run). If a future test needs a converted lead to verify the 'reassign row hidden when converted' branch, either seed one via /api/leads with status='converted' or convert one of the existing follow-up leads and then check the dialog. Direct URL navigation on this app can hang on the auth 'LOADING' gate — always log in via the /login form and then click sidebar links.
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature works end-to-end (backend + frontend + activity log).
